verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's developer docs say developers can "extend checkout" and list a first-party Checkout SDK (checkout-sdk-js), which points to a supported extension point rather than forking. The pack has only these thin mentions and nothing showing how fields, branding, discounts or validation logic would actually be customized. Missing for 10: documented custom checkout fields, checkout branding/styling controls, discount/promotion hooks at checkout, custom validation logic extension points, and independent or hands-on corroboration of checkout customization.
